diagnosis: The shortened proof is structurally sound, but passes the polymorphic theorem `HomBisimilarity.refl` without applying it to the successor state. Specializing it with `_` gives the required self-bisimilarity while preserving the reduced proof.
proof_body:
by
  intro h
  use @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  constructor
  · intro s1' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨q', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨q', htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
  · intro s2' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨p', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨p', htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
